prompt: curl upload-file stdin non-blocking mode filename
answer:
Use a single period (`.`) as the `--upload-file` filename:

```sh
curl --upload-file . https://example.com/upload
```

With `-T .` or `--upload-file .`, curl reads from stdin in non-blocking mode, allowing it to read server output while stdin is being uploaded. A single dash (`-`) also reads stdin, but without the stated non-blocking behavior.
